description_en: The smartest way to learn touch typing and improve your typing speed.
readme_excerpt: keybr.com is not (just) a typing test It's the smartest way to learn touch typing and improve your typing speed. On the surface, it looks pretty simple: it shows you a piece of text, and you type it out. But the devil is in the details — keybr.com offers a few unique features: keybr.com tracks every single keystroke and computes statistics for each individual key.
